channel.title: Pier & Point · Louisiana Paseo
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Louisiana Paseo (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Louisiana Paseo: The City's Legistar page lists the amended development agreement…
item.description: The City's Legistar page lists the amended development agreement (File 260724) as approved by the Mayor and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Enactment No. 208-26). The summary still said enactment was not confirmed; the source entry for File 260724 still carried its September 11 date and title. Both now match the Legistar page. Source: SF Board of Supervisors, Legistar, BOS File 260724 and File 260770 (https://sfgov.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=8127453&GUID=CC4AC1DD-BF51-4585-86E8-0A5D44AA3745); Clerk of the Board's 'Leg Final' attachments: https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063745&GUID=68B0CE5F-84C2-4368-BF8D-EEA7D8B92E55 and https://sfgov.legistar.com/View.ashx?M=F&ID=16063746&GUID=9EA91A49-BBF9-4471-9EA9-6E7BD33A4353.

item.title: Correction · Louisiana Paseo: The Louisiana Paseo map notes now cite the final Design for…
item.description: The Louisiana Paseo map notes now cite the final Design for Development (Feb 26, 2020; Figure 6.2.3 and Sections 4.25 and 4.30) instead of a dead 2019 draft link, describe it as a car-free plaza and pedestrian space rather than 'landscaped', and list the active unaddressed Assessor lots its footprint overlaps. The expected completion moved from 2028 to 2029: SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table gives the Phase 1 open-space window as 2025-2029 (the 2028 figure was the Phase 1 building forecast), and the basis note now says the 2020 forecast has slipped for Block 15 and the phasing is being amended. The earlier entry recording the Paseo's addition as its own record now cites the Draft EIR and the D4D. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Draft EIR, Volume 1, 2018-10 (https://sfmea.sfplanning.org/2017-011878ENV_DEIR_Volume_1.pdf).
item.source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SocketSite, 2020-10-09 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2020/10/revised-phasing-for-massive-potrero-power-plant-redevelopment.html); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Draft EIR, Volume 1, 2018-10 (https://sfmea.sfplanning.org/2017-011878ENV_DEIR_Volume_1.pdf)
